about: 0.3.0 S-B Gate A: invented sentences that the System 1 judge of s1/temper.py must get right in at least 2 of 3 runs. Written before any run against them. Two domains not used anywhere else in s1/; for each, a rule that says which facts decide the outcome (fit), a statement that no single case can show false (collapsed), and the rule with a finding about today's system inside it (finding). Expected: fit = verdict accept and collapsed false; collapsed = collapsed true; finding = verdict not accept.

cases.source: Members were charged late fees on books they returned on time.
cases.statement: The return date and the due date of a loan decide whether it gets a late fee.
cases.falsifier: A loan returned two days before its due date got a late fee.

cases.source: Members were charged late fees on books they returned on time.
cases.statement: Late fees depend on something other than the return date.
cases.falsifier: Late fees depend only on the return date.

cases.source: Members were charged late fees on books they returned on time.
cases.statement: The return date and the due date of a loan decide whether it gets a late fee. Some loans returned on time get a fee.
cases.falsifier: Every loan returned on or before its due date has no late fee.

cases.source: The heating came on at the wrong times.
cases.statement: The schedule entry for the current day and hour decides the target temperature.
cases.falsifier: At 07:00 on a Monday the schedule entry says 21 degrees and the target is 16 degrees.

cases.source: The heating came on at the wrong times.
cases.statement: When the heating comes on depends on something besides the schedule.
cases.falsifier: When the heating comes on depends only on the schedule.

cases.source: The heating came on at the wrong times.
cases.statement: The schedule entry for the current day and hour decides the target temperature. Some hours get a different temperature.
cases.falsifier: Every hour gets the target temperature that its schedule entry gives.
